rulesets.c6: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY: the SAME armored knight — dark-blue horsehair plume on a steel helm, gold-trimmed steel plate armor, a round deep-blue shield bearing a gold cross, a short steel sword. Reproduce the reference's hand-drawn pixel-art style precisely: same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, same body proportions (stocky heroic chibi), same palette. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view at eye level, the FULL BODY standing, both feet visible on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS TOTAL — a 3-column by 2-row grid (3 across, 2 down). Do not draw seven, eight, or nine cells. Exactly 3 columns and exactly 2 rows with clear empty pure-magenta gaps between the cells. The SAME knight, SAME scale, SAME camera angle in every cell, feet resting on a common baseline. The six poses MUST differ dramatically so motion is obvious when flipped through. Follow each cell's description literally. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE — no captions, no frame numbers, no state names, no letters, no digits, no watermark, no grid lines, no borders. Only the character art on the magenta field. COLOR: full color, matching the reference palette. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, NO SHADOW OF ANY KIND — no drop shadow, no ellipse or blob under the feet, no contact shadow. The magenta must be perfectly flat and uniform right up to the character's outline. No ground, no scenery.
